mapper.select: SELECT id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, status, completed_by, completed_at, created_at FROM workflow_tasks WHERE workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CASE task_key WHEN 'PURCHASER_REVIEW' THEN 1 WHEN 'LEGAL_REVIEW' THEN 2 WHEN 'FINANCE_REVIEW' THEN 3 WHEN 'OPERATIONS_ACTIVATION' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END

SELECT id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, status, completed_by, completed_at, created_at FROM workflow_tasks WHERE workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed_at ASC

SELECT id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, status, completed_by, completed_at, created_at FROM workflow_tasks WHERE workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_key = #{taskKey} AND status = 'PENDING' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_tasks (id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, status, completed_by, completed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{taskKey}, #{status}, #{completedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt})
